chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, and Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father, and Sahl ibn Ziyad, all from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Ubayda al-Hadda', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who loves for the Sake of Allah and hates for the Sake of Allah and gives for the Sake of Allah, he is from those whose faith is perfect.

key_terms.أَبْغَضَ لِلَّهِ: Hates for the Sake of Allah
key_terms.أَحَبَّ لِلَّهِ: Loves for the Sake of Allah
key_terms.أَعْطَى لِلَّهِ: Gives for the Sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of perfect faith according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In Shia theology, this hadith from al-Kafi establishes 'al-wala' wa al-barra' (affiliation and disaffiliation) as the litmus test for complete faith, where one's emotional attachments and charitable acts are strictly aligned with divine pleasure. Scholars emphasize that this triad of loving, hating, and giving 'for Allah' signifies a purification of the self from worldly desires, ensuring that all actions serve as manifestations of monotheistic devotion.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, and Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali BinRaib, from Abu Ubeyda Al Haza’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who loves for the Sake of Allahazwj and hates for the Sake of Allahazwj, so he is from the ones whose Emān is perfect’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Sahl ibn Ziyad all from ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri’ab from abu ‘Ubaydah al-Hadhdha’ from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Whoever loves for the sake of Allah, hates for the sake of Allah and gives for the sake of Allah, he is of those whose belief is complete.’”
